findings.text: the assertion compares os.environ["RECKON_FOLLOWER_OWNER"] against the literal "a-test-owner" that line 100 supplied to that same variable, so the two sides move together: monkeypatch.setenv overrides both the autouse fixture's delenv and any ambient value, so the assertion holds whether the fixture is present, absent, or set to something else, and it survives the very regression it names for coverage. Reverting the fixture leaves it green.

the five-runs-alone control that adjudicates the two derived added ids as environment-independent is itself asymmetric: this cleared arm reports 4 failed of 5 while the matching set arm reports 0 of 5, a 4/5-versus-0/5 split between arms that the manifest attributes to machine warm-up without a control for arm order or warm-up. Both arms carry the fixture at head, so the arms should be equivalent samples of the same code, and the residual difference is the reason the derived count of 2 is retired rather than the reason it is absent.
